summary: Battle UI manager for one battle: owns the battle camera / target-panel look-at transforms, the 16 balloon slots, six embedded sub-panels, two 0x5BCC-byte party row panels, 16 member screens and the per-balloon state machine that drives the message balloons.
evidence: Battle_Ui_Ctor (0x0047DEA0) starts with Ui_Screen_CtorBaseEx (0x004BF110, "extended base constructor for 0x129C-byte actor/battle/UI sequence objects"), stores vtable 0x0076ECD8 at +0, then constructs the embedded TextRow at +0x129C (Text_Row_Init 0x0049AA0C), the Ui_TextLineCache at +0x1354 (0x00398B28) and the object at +0x17EC, and finally runs std_ConstructArray on the two party row panels at +0x18B4. The batch base "Ui_ActionPane" comes from a base-constructor call seen in only 6 of the 233 functions, so Ui_Screen is used. The class is a namespace merge of 233 Battle_Ui_* functions: 29 of the 388 reported offsets are vtable-slot artefacts (struct_db multiplied the slot offset by 4), 22 come from one function with damaged decompilation (0x00483308, halt_baddata) and 2 are far outside the layout (0x5FB00/0x5FB0C, mistyped self). The remaining offsets are real members of this object; the last one (+0xED68) ends at 60,780 bytes, so the batch size 60,776 (highest *strong* field) is raised by 4.
